evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence reviewed during Skill Research Batch 458.
findings: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from Expert Mission 8. The user jumps upward and rains Ki Blasts downward in a long-range, 21-hit projectile sequence with knockback and about 30% source-reported total damage. Community usage notes are kept separate from deterministic mechanics.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent scaling is not inferred from source-reported values.
Reward probabilities and hidden prerequisites are not promoted unless directly evidenced.
Community usage commentary is not converted into deterministic mechanics.
